About the Project

IMPRS Condensed Matter and Quantum Materials recruits candidates for research in the physics of materials and complex systems. Successful applicants are expected to begin their project by September 2027. The exact funding arrangement should be checked with the selected host group.

Research Areas

  • Condensed matter physics
  • Quantum materials
  • Physics

About Max Planck Society

The Max Planck Society operates research institutes and International Max Planck Research Schools in Germany. Doctoral candidates work within a selected institute or partner university, with funding and supervision arranged through the programme or project.
